summary: Health check and root info endpoints on the main FastAPI application: GET /health returns a JSON liveness response used by Cloud Run and load balancers to verify the service is running before routing traffic, and GET / returns a root welcome/info JSON response for service identification. Both endpoints require no authentication.

evidence.claim: GET /health returns a HealthResponse JSON for Cloud Run liveness probing
GET / returns a RedirectResponse or root welcome JSON from the main FastAPI application
Both endpoints are defined in src/edullm_sat/api/app.py as top-level app routes

invariants.statement: Both endpoints require no authentication and are always publicly accessible
GET /health is used by Cloud Run for liveness probing before traffic is routed

scenarios.name: Cloud Run liveness probe
scenarios.given: A deployed Cloud Run instance of the main API
scenarios.then: A JSON health status response is returned indicating the service is alive

scenarios.name: service identification
scenarios.given: Any caller wanting to confirm they hit the right service
scenarios.then: A root JSON welcome/info response is returned identifying the service
